headword: {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}

definitions.explanation: Measures and plans put in place to prepare for, respond to, or recover from natural or man-made disasters. A vital concept in disaster-prone Japan.

examples.japanese: {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}を{見直|みなお}す。
{市|し}は{新|あたら}しい{災害対策|さいがいたいさく}マニュアルを{作成|さくせい}した。
examples.english: The city created a new disaster preparedness manual.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}が{多|おお}い{地域|ちいき}では、{日頃|ひごろ}からの{災害対策|さいがいたいさく}が{命|いのち}を{守|まも}ることにつながる。
examples.english: In earthquake-prone regions, routine disaster preparedness can save lives.

notes:
A compound of {災害|さいがい} (disaster) and {対策|たいさく} (countermeasures). Covers a wide range of activities including evacuation planning, supply stockpiling, infrastructure reinforcement, and public awareness campaigns. Frequently seen in government communications and news reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}を{講|こう}じる: to implement disaster measures
- {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}{本部|ほんぶ}: disaster response headquarters
- {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}{基本法|きほんほう}: Basic Act on Disaster Countermeasures
- {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}マニュアル: disaster preparedness manual
- {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}を{強化|きょうか}する: to strengthen disaster measures

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan experiences frequent earthquakes, typhoons, flooding, and volcanic activity. {災害対策|さいがいたいさく} is a core concept in Japanese public administration. Most municipalities maintain {災害対策|さいがいたいさく}{本部|ほんぶ} (disaster response headquarters) that are activated during emergencies.

RELATED WORDS:
- {防災|ぼうさい}: disaster prevention
- {避難|ひなん}: evacuation
- {備蓄|びちく}: stockpiling (emergency supplies)
